name: Betahistine
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 8 to 16 mg three times daily with meals; usual maintenance 24 to 48 mg/day

key_interactions.effect: Theoretical loss of effect of either drug.
key_interactions.action: Usually no action; review need for both.

monitoring: Symptom response; bronchospasm in patients with asthma

pk.bioavailability: Almost completely absorbed (parent levels very low)
pk.peak: 2-PAA peaks about 1 hour after a dose
pk.metabolism: Rapid, almost complete conversion to inactive 2-PAA

sources.citation: Azure Pharmaceuticals Ltd.. (2024). Betahistine dihydrochloride 16 mg tablets [Summary of product characteristics, licence PA22871/017/002; text revised September 2024 (document date; section 10 blank)]. Health Products Regulatory Authority (Ireland).
